digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter adapter — transport and settings
propositions: When JIRA_PAT is missing from the environment, the adapter silently falls back to anonymous access instead of failing with an explicit error naming the variable.
The documented security guarantee states that a missing JIRA_PAT fails with a named error; this guarantee is not enforced and the code currently passes an empty string as the bearer token.

Missing or whitespace-only PAT validation must occur in build_client_from_settings before client construction, not in settings resolution, to avoid breaking Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks via hasattr.
Settings resolution must remain total (not raise) so that isinstance and hasattr checks work on all interpreter versions; validation belongs strictly at client construction.
Anonymous requests to Jira misattribute the failure as project-not-found rather than credential-missing, causing operators to debug the wrong problem.
A PAT present only in the config file must not satisfy any check, preserving the documented environment-only contract.
